Title: Tutorial: Getting Hammered
Descriptions: Well %1, you've done more than most freelancers, but I have another mission for you. There is a man named Drew, who some people have started calling 'The Hammer', because of his absurd punch strength. He leads a group called the Brawlers, which have been beating our volunteers to near death with their fists. I want you to teach him and those like him a lesson. Beat him down with this hammer, and then I have a special gift. An Admin Hammer! It lets you build base structures without needing nails, wood, or metal. Oh, but be careful. His reputation is warranted.
